text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Reality is full of all sorts of "lip service."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You, and you, and even you are the protagonist."
...As if to say, there are no side characters.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
However, the protagonist of a manga
is decided the moment they appear.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa~ So this rival was fighting
to carry on his older brother's will...
*sniff*... Man, this really brings tears to my eyes~"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how much supporting characters add color to a story,
it's the 'protagonist' who stands at its center.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist is the one who makes the story exciting.
The protagonist is the one who drives the story forward.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I want to surpass Almond Eye! I want to win! I want to rewrite history!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if you are a protagonist so dazzling it blinds!
I will create an even greater thrill with these legs of mine!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki! It's Kiseki!
Shaking off the fierce pursuit of the Triple Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Kiseki is! Kiseki has held on to the lead and—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...You really are incredible after all, aren't you?
Celebratory confetti rains down onto the turf.
Surrounded by that vibrant scenery, the two, having given it their all, pulled each other into a firm embrace and praised one another's valiant efforts.

I reached out with my right hand toward Kiseki
as she made her way into the winner's circle.
choice_data_list: Come over here! Get closer to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for such an incredible race, Kiseki!!
I'll never forget this day for the rest of my life!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"That was awesome! It was so much fun!!
Your race... was the best!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: You're the one who created this deeply moving moment.
You're the one who created this deeply moving moment.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: Yeah, my heart's been pounding the whole time.
Yeah, my heart was racing the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Have you become completely captivated
by the creations I make?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I am the protagonist!!
The protagonist of a true masterpiece...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I didn't give up...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so glad... I can stand here...!
"Even if that reply doesn't take voice, her feelings come through loud and clear."

The conclusion we reached together.
Kiseki had—triumphed over Almond Eye.
